notes.title: State of Affairs: 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171093/c2389b82c9c07ad138b505fd5410abe4993ed2b3.png[/img]

Firstly, we would like to thank you for your support! Whether you bought the game at launch or you are one of the many new players who picked up the game during the recent sales, we want you to know that it means a lot to us. Thank you!

Secondly we would like to outline our plan for 2025, and the things you can expect the year to bring.

We are committed to improving the game within the current scope, but we rely on players leaving feedback to do so. As they are brought forth, bug fixes and minor adjustments will continue through 2025.

Additionally we also have plans for one more major content update at some point throughout the year. This update will include a new game mode distinctly different from the Story Mode and Arcade Mode already available in the game. Please look forward to it!

As always, if there are changes that you feel that the game could strongly benefit from or we haven't followed up one of your community post, please let us know in the comments to this post. 

WAH! Thanks again for your support!

notes.title: Change Log - Revision 2.11s
notes.notes:
The following changes have been implemented into revision 2.11s:
[h1]Major Bug Fix[/h1]
A bug that affected Arcade Mode's last level has been addressed where the camera would scroll past the end of the level. 

Apologies for any inconvenience this might have caused.
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Change Log - Revision 2.1s
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171093/5b37c5ee5bfeb974007dc1e045044feb8f7f1510.png[/img]
The following changes have been implemented into revision 2.1s:

[h1]Minor Bug Fixes[/h1]
A few smaller bugs have been ironed out, as well as one that affected the cutscenes of players using the Japanese language option.

[h1]Options Menu[/h1]
As promised, we have implemented an Options Menu with features players have requested from the community such as audio adjustments. 
The Options are:
[list]
[*][b]Background Music Level[/b] - (0%-100%)  - Changes the sound output level of the Background music.
[*][b]Sound Effect and Voice[/b]  - (0%-100%) - Changes the sound output level of Sound Effects.
[*][b]Marker Sensitivity (Controller Only)[/b] - (50%-150%) - Changes the speed the Marker moves.
[*][b]Marker Guide Lines[/b] - (On/Off) - Toggle the visibility of the guides around the marker.
[*][b]Ina's Costume[/b] - (3 selections) - Changes Ina's appearance in-game.
[/list]
The Options Menu is accessed from the Main Menu where previously the Input Legend was accessible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171093/54bfb2be113681a1e17cedb999e18bdee8aad228.png[/img]

[h1]Marker Maker[/h1]
[b]Dr. Oopsie has found a way to bring Markers out from the void![/b]
You can now customise the targeting Marker. There are a few different designs you can mix and match to make something that will work for you. Additionally there are 7 preset colours to select from, pick your favourite! We hope this will solve the issue some players reported, where they had trouble keeping track of their Marker during gameplay. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171093/aa5c049335f0b255d0055fd89b3763b40f29e896.png[/img]

[h1]Costumes[/h1]
The game now has two additional costumes for Ina to wear on her adventure! One of them is the illustrious Dr. Oopsie! The other costume is something a little more... festive. You can toggle between them in the Options Menu. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171093/3331d9457041bb64dd9464b60b082c8171c7948a.png[/img]

We hope you all like these changes and we would again like to thank you all for your support.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Change Log - Revision 2.02s
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171093/070de17d456a6fed0be78605864664672cc4a060.png[/img]
The following changes have been implemented into revision 2.02s:

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
The Stage Select bug where levels could be selected before unlocking them has been fixed. There are a few other minor changes under the hood but the overall gameplay experience remains the same.

[h1]Reticle Design[/h1]
We've implemented some visual changes to the reticle based on player feedback. For now there is only the one new design. We hope the reticle will be easier for players to keep track of.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171093/0949e9ffe74a60f063d7b876b1c53a782ae21cfa.png[/img]

[h1]Controller Support[/h1]
Controller support has been added to make the game a little more accessible to those of you who found the mouse and keyboard controls tricky. It should just be as easy as connecting your Xbox controller, you can switch seamlessly switch between controller and the mouse/keyboard controls. You can also play using half and half if you want a joystick for movement and the mouse for aiming. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171093/537a015c1b130bbb9e95abf81555318b15c4a712.png[/img]

[h1]Arcade Mode Quick Reset[/h1]
Arcade Mode can now be Reset from the PAUSE screen, saving you from going back to the main menu if you mess up your run.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171093/bfa7964066a173f17d7e8d1f9ea81744a212630a.png[/img]

We hope you like these changes and as previously mentioned there will be an update in November where we will be adding a dedicated options menu.

In the meantime, enjoy these additions and thanks for playing!

notes.title: State of Affairs: Oct - Nov
notes.notes:
We would like to take a moment to outline our plan the game over the next two months. Both in regards to what you can expect will be added to the game, but also how you can help us release the best possible update.

We've been reading your feedback and aside from addressing bugs, some players have requested features that we would very much like to add now that we are aware that there is a demand for them.

There will be two updates in this period, one minor, and one major.

[h2]End of October (minor update)[/h2]
[list]
[*]Bug fixes
[*]Minor adjustments 
[/list]

[H2]End of November (major update)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dedicated Options Menu
[*] Partial Sound Options 
[*] Reticle/Markers Selection
[*] Partial Controller Support 
[/list]

These plans may come to change. The current lists may not reflect the changes at the time of release, but these are the things we hope to be able to address.

Now, if there are changes that you feel that the game could strongly benefit from and we haven't followed up your community post, please let us know in the comments to this post. We do take on board and consider all feedback, but keep in mind that we also won't implement every idea brought forward.

Once again, a big thank you to each and every one of you for your support!

notes.title: We Are Humbled!
notes.notes:
We would like to extend our gratitude and thanks to all of you who have shown support for our game: The Adventure of Ninomae Ina'nis. Though it has only been a week since the game launched, it's felt like the longest week of our lives. Time and time again we have been humbled by your excitement and enthusiasm and it has been wonderful.

So we would like to thank you, all of you, for your wonderful words of support! Thank you for your reviews, and thank you for your community posts. Thank you for playing our game! 

WAH! (We are humbled!)

Some additional words from artist Jean:
"It's been a crazy couple of days, everyone's feedback has been amazing, and Ina's stream demoing the game almost made us faint!

We will keep trying our best, and to all our fellow takodachi, o7"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171093/0ad7960b7707b1686e1f34b82ac2bbd7a56a95d8.png[/img]

notes.title: Change Log - Revision 2.01s
notes.notes:
The following changes have been implemented into revision 2.01s:
[h1]Auto Fire[/h1]
Pressing the right mouse button will cycle the auto fire between on or off. The left mouse button will also disable the auto fire if it is active. This functions across all game modes.

[h1]Baby Mode Toggle[/h1]
On the menu screen for both [b]Story Mode[/b] and [b]Another Tomorrow?![/b] players will now be able to enable [b]Baby Mode[/b]. The following modifiers are then added to these game modes:
[list]
[*] Dr. Oopsie will restore 5 hearts.
[*] Stages will have a mid stage Checkpoint about halfway though.
[/list]
Note that checkpoints aren't written to save data, and that [b]Baby Mode[/b] can be enabled or disabled regardless of your progress through the Story Mode from the Story Menu. 

We hope these changes make the casual game modes a little more accessible to those of you who might have previously struggled.
Thanks for playing!
